title: Member Handbook — Asking for a Different Care Team Lead in Care Management
content:
In Care Management you may ask for a different care team lead up to the number of times your tier allows within a rolling 365 days. Changes made for caseload rebalancing, or because a lead leaves, never count.

## Your allowance

- The count is the number of changes of care team lead recorded on your episode with the reason that you asked for them, within the rolling 365 calendar days that end on the day of your new request, that day included.
- A change made to rebalance caseloads, or because your lead left, is recorded but never counts toward your allowance.
- Every change of care team lead, whatever its reason, is logged on your episode with its date and the new lead.

## Counting window (hypothetical)

For a request made on 20 September 2026, the rolling 365 days run from 21 September 2025 through 20 September 2026.

| Earlier change on the episode | Reason | Counts toward the allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 15 September 2025 | Member request | No, outside the 365 days |
| 2 February 2026 | Caseload rebalancing | No, never counts |
| 11 May 2026 | Member request | Yes |
| 30 June 2026 | Lead left | No, never counts |

Count: 1. In a tier that allows 1 member-requested change within a rolling 365 days, the member has already used that change, and a further one would go beyond the number the tier allows; in a tier that allows 2, one member-requested change remains.
